title: Terrible app - save your money!
text:
I really wanted to love this app. But there are just so many issues that are unacceptable considering how much they charge for the annual subscription. 

You write a note onto a receipt in the notes field, and you can’t even search by keywords later to find it. What’s the point? 

When you scan the receipts in, it assigns the date you scanned it in, and there is no way to sort by date on the actual receipts. So if you scan a bunch of receipts or invoices from August, they will show up as the date you scan them in in December. It’s very confusing and totally stupid.

No way to export your data in any sort of meaningful way.

Basically, your data is just trapped inside this app without the ability to even filter sort or search in any way that is actually useful.

Once you purchase, and realize all of the downfalls of this app, all the time you wasted scanning receipts is gone in the wind.

I have written them several times asking them to add these basic features and push them via an update, but nope. They refuse to give us any updates. We are stuck with this app the way it is. They simply don’t care. It’s a money grab.

I’ll be cancelling my annual plan and continuing the neverending search for app that actually works, and isn’t over priced. 1/10 rating. Smh

text:
I seldom if ever give a negative review to an App. I do know there are people working and App need to have a price. However, I bought this one by mistake (my fault), I didn’t realize they were charging $99 just a week later. 
The App is not worth 99$ at all, it is too simple, and what it give you is not much. A scan, and a total grouped in folders. That is not much, and doesn’t justify that amount of money. 
Moreover, I use the App to keep track of expenses in US$, I scan receipts in US$, but the app recognize that I am not in the US and converts the amount from another currency into US$. Absurd! 
The online version is also poorly done, a simple spreadsheet, nothing more. That again is not worth that money. There are other Apps that do the same with better interface for free. 
I paid, I shall keep it for a while not to feel too bad, then I shall delete it.

title: 5 star app with a 1 star Rating. Here’s why!
text:
This app is actually fantastic.. for the most part. This is easily a five star app but I have to give it a one star rating in hopes that this company recognizes they are missing on a huge point. 

Return Receipts…

Unfortunately if you scan a receipt that’s a return it keeps the number positive instead of negative so you can not accurately keep track of your “total” in specific folders. This is a massive miss for exporting when it’s tax season. It doesn’t seam that updating your app to reflect the negative symbol would be very difficult to do. Once this is corrected I would easily change my review to 5stars. Until then I highly recommend looking else ware and not spending any additional money on the subscription for this app!

title: Doesn’t have it all
text: This app does ALMOST everything. The export feature is spot on. And I like the simplicity of it. Good design. Not overwhelming to learn or visual sensory overload. Those are all good things. Some improvements need to be made to the categorisation system. It isn’t accurate. It doesn’t need to be perfect, but it took a Whole Foods receipt and categorised it as office supplies. Something that says food and has food items all over the receipt is not an ambiguous categorisation. In addition, it needs to divide the categories into a chart or graph so you can identify what your expenses are going toward. Where’s an app that can take a pic of a receipt, categorise it appropriately, and then show a charted or graphed summary of the data? Combine that with the export and business features this app already has.. Now that would be a powerful budgeting and recording app suited for everyone’s needs.
